Attribute only the action linked to an actor; neighboring passive clauses can have unknown actors. Source event dates, including unambiguous journal headings, differ from text-change dates. Missing completion evidence means unestablished, not failed or definitely unfinished. Unknown event timing stays unknown in the conclusion; do not call it likely within the period. Do not choose a conflicting account merely because it was edited last.
